rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that increases a signal or intensifies an effect, including an electronic amplifier.

example.english: This amplifier can boost a weak signal.
example.traditional: 呢部放大器可以將個微弱訊號放大。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 fong3 daai6 hei3 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 mei4 joek6 seon3 hou6 fong3 daai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for an audio amplifier or sound-system appliance rather than an amplifier in the general technical sense.

example.english: The concert needs a louder amplifier.
example.traditional: 音樂會要換部大聲啲嘅擴音機。
example.jyutping: jam1 ngok6 wui2 jiu3 wun6 bou6 daai6 seng1 di1 ge3 kwok3 jam1 gei1
